episodeTitle.en: Unconventional product lessons from Binance, N26, Google, more | Mayur Kamat (CPO at N26)
episodeTitle.zh: 来自币安、N26、谷歌等公司的非传统产品经验 | 梅尤尔·卡马特（N26首席产品官）

guestBioOfficial.en: Mayur Kamat is the chief product officer at N26—a $9 billion neobank serving over 7 million customers in 25 countries—where he leads product, design, data, and research. Prior to N26, Mayur was Head of Product at Binance, growing the crypto exchange to a peak $400 billion valuation. Earlier in his career, he built and scaled products at Google (Gmail Mobile, Hangouts), Microsoft, and travel unicorn Agoda. Learn:
guestBioOfficial.zh: 梅尤尔·卡马特是N26的首席产品官——这家市值90亿美元的新型银行在25个国家拥有超过700万客户，提供超过125,000种产品，是全球最受欢迎的项目管理工具。在加入N26之前，梅尤尔曾在币安担任产品主管，将这家加密货币交易所发展至市值400亿美元的巅峰。在职业生涯早期，他曾在谷歌（Gmail移动版、Hangouts）、微软和旅游独角兽Agoda开发和管理产品。学习：

title.en: Unconventional product lessons from Binance, N26, Google, more | Mayur Kamat (CPO at N26)
title.zh: 来自币安、N26、谷歌等公司的非传统产品经验 | 梅尤尔·卡马特（N26首席产品官）

summary.en: Mayur shares his biggest failure - leading Hangouts at Google with vast resources yet failing to build a great messaging product - and the lesson that strategy is overrated versus speed from hypothesis to data. He advises PMs to make experimentation scientific rather than opinion-driven. The episode is a candid look at product leadership at hyper-scale.
summary.zh: 马尤尔分享了他最大的失败——在 Google 手握海量资源领导 Hangouts，却没能做出一款出色的通讯产品——并得出教训：相比"从假设到数据"的速度，战略往往被高估。他建议 PM 把实验变得科学化，而非靠观点驱动。本期坦诚呈现了超大规模下的产品领导力。
